purpose: Show campaigns agents can run under policy and which ones are blocked by provider, platform, data, or escalation rules.

left.current_focus: Repair the Square provider/payment blocker and checkout confirmation path without Middle changing checkout/pricing files.

middle.owns: Revenue execution, CTOS operations, outbound, inbound, follow-ups, lead movement, revenue scoreboard, and ad-response capture
middle.current_focus: Run policy-based revenue workflows and move leads inside approved rules.

right.owns: Video production, Instagram content, Higgsfield generation, and first ad launch
right.current_focus: Create first ad/post assets while Middle builds the capture and revenue loop behind them.

campaigns.name: Sunday Instagram Local Founder Revenue Sprint
campaigns.ai_next_action: Research 11 source-backed segment queues, create real lead records, generate policy-checked DMs, and send only after Instagram runtime confirms provider access.
campaigns.escalation_only_if: provider block, rate limit, known relationship, custom promise, or trust-risk
campaigns.blocker: No real source-backed leads researched in this run; Instagram outbound runtime not proven here.
campaigns.revenue_connection: Warm conversations with local service owners.

campaigns.name: First Ad Inbound Capture Loop
campaigns.ai_next_action: Classify ad comments/DMs, create lead records, draft or send low-risk replies when provider is connected, and schedule follow-ups.
campaigns.escalation_only_if: known relationship, meeting with Wallace, custom pricing, proof request, angry/sensitive reply, or provider block
campaigns.blocker: Waiting on Right lane first ad/post and Instagram inbound POST proof.

campaigns.name: Right Lane First Video/Instagram Ad Launch
campaigns.ai_next_action: Produce Higgsfield/video/Instagram creative; hand comments, DMs, and launch metadata into Middle capture workflow.
campaigns.escalation_only_if: unsupported claim, trust-risk, or strategic ad decision
campaigns.blocker: Creative/ad asset production is outside Middle lane.
campaigns.revenue_connection: Creates attention that CTOS can convert into tracked leads.

campaigns.name: Policy-Based Warm Follow-Up
campaigns.ai_next_action: Send non-sensitive due follow-ups inside policy; current known warm leads remain escalated or waiting on context.
campaigns.escalation_only_if: known relationship, meeting with Wallace, custom terms, sensitive context, provider missing
campaigns.blocker: Known warm items are relationship, sensitive, current customer, or missing-context cases.

campaigns.name: Facebook Advice-Post
campaigns.ai_next_action: Generate and policy-check posts; publish only if adapter confirms platform/group rules allow it.
campaigns.escalation_only_if: group rules unclear, public trust risk, platform confirmation required

campaigns.name: Instantly Local Service Email
campaigns.ai_next_action: Prepare source-review, suppression, and campaign draft locally.
campaigns.escalation_only_if: provider setup, source uncertainty, spam-risk, campaign start

campaigns.name: Missed-Call Content
campaigns.ai_next_action: Generate hooks/captions from approved brand voice and missed-call pain.
campaigns.escalation_only_if: public posting adapter required, personal story detail, unsupported proof

campaigns.name: Square Payment/Checkout Provider Repair
campaigns.ai_next_action: Left repairs Square/payment/checkout provider issue. Middle does not edit checkout/pricing.
campaigns.escalation_only_if: provider access, payment setting change, checkout link replacement, or deploy
campaigns.blocker: Provider/payment work is owned by Left.
